verdict.rationale: Foreloop has event-triggered automation baked into fixed workflows — PRs opened trigger automatic reviews, @foreloop retest and @foreloop link commands trigger re-checks/linking, and feedback submissions trigger an agent to draft intentions/tasks — but these are pre-built product behaviors, not a general user-defined rules engine (no 'if X event then Y action' rule builder across arbitrary triggers/actions). missing for 10: a configurable rules/automation engine letting users define arbitrary event-action bindings, evidence of custom triggers beyond PR/webhook/feedback events, and any UI or API for creating/editing rules.
